basic_info.description: Everything you need to move in and start living. Must see to appreciate and easy to show anytime -Rare TOP floor 2-level loft has brand new floors, washer/dryer, gas range and dishwasher. The open living & dining area with skylight provides amazing natural light with floor-to-ceiling windows to show off your biggest art pieces. The condo is further enhanced with in-unit laundry, touchless faucet, private patio deck, gas fireplace & pristine floors on both levels and staircase. The sparkling spa-like bathrooms feature white marble tile & under-cabinet lighting. Deeded parking and large storage showcase the builders care to detail. H2O Lofts is a highly sought-after boutique elevator bldg with fine architectural details, strong HOA reserves and excellent community featuring just 28 homes. This is not your typical loft in SOMA with top floor, no shared walls on 3 sides and excellent cross breeze. Easy access to Downtown, Hayes Valley, Mission Bay, Potrero, Valencia, freeways, bridges, ballparks, museums, bars, restaurants, Caltrain, Bart and Muni means you can get anywhere you need to go quickly.
